messages:
Nina Gomez: Kicking off a controlled bring-up for 'rwd-v4-int4' at 5% sessions in prod-eu-west, 09:05 UTC. Objective: measure hallucination rate on FAQ-style prompts + latency tail with long context.

ci-bot: Canary scheduled: rwd-v4-int4 -> 5% sessions (session-hash 0-4). Monitoring suite: /dash/canary/rwd-v4-int4, runbook /runbooks/canary-onboard.md

Ravi Patel: routing sticky, correct? we don't want mid-session switches.

Nina Gomez: yes sticky. Also enabling per-route shadowing for 'faq' intent at 100% to collect more references.

Leo Zhang: first 20m numbers: p95 latency -12%, p99 -5% (weird), throughput +8%. Hallucination signal (answering with unsupported facts) +1.2% absolute vs baseline on the FAQ slice.

Ravi Patel: what's our alarm for hallucination?

Nina Gomez: proposed thresholds:
- session-level hallucination rate delta >= 1.5% AND sample_count >= 50 -> per-session fallback
- global hallucination delta >= 1.0% over 45m with p<0.05 -> pause expansion and reduce to 2.5%
- enterprise accounts: if >0.5% of their sessions hallucinate by >1% -> ops notify, do not auto-fallback without approval

Leo Zhang: we should also track "confident hallucinations" (model assigns high prob to incorrect tokens). propose KL on top-k vs baseline > 0.015 as additional trigger.

Nina Gomez: adding that. Also require bootstrap CI and min_sample 150 for global checks.

ci-bot: Alert hook configured. Any firing rule will post to #eng-ml and page ops-oncall if enterprise account impacted.

Ravi Patel: initial sample counts look low for long-context (>512) slice — only 32 samples. We'll keep shadowing to bump that.

Leo Zhang: note: tokenization edge case observed where multi-byte sequence "→→" merges differently under quantized weights. Seen in 7 examples so far. Adding sanitizer: normalize all repeated arrows to single space-separated tokens in the pretokenize hook.

Nina Gomez: can we avoid auto-fallback for users in experimental cohorts? those slices expected to be noisy.

Ravi Patel: experimental cohorts excluded from auto-global thresholds; per-session fallback still allowed.

ci-bot: Canary started at 09:05 UTC.

09:40 update — sample_count 480, global hallucination delta +0.9% (p=0.07), faq slice delta +1.6% (samples 210), p=0.02.

Leo Zhang: faq slice crossing per-session threshold — detected 18 sessions with session-level delta >=1.5%.

Nina Gomez: apply per-session fallback for those sessions. Also start partial-degrade plan: reduce to 2% for next 20m if faq slice stays bad.

ops-oncall: paging — acct-88 (enterprise) shows 0.8% hallucination rate increase on faq slice. ops note: require manual approval before routing.

Nina Gomez: acknowledged. Not auto-fallbacking enterprise acct-88. SE notified to confirm.

Ravi Patel: 10:05 update — faq slice delta down to +0.3% after sanitizer; global delta +0.5%. Long-context samples 98 now, delta stable. Latency still improved.

Leo Zhang: action items after window: run tokenization ablation, add sanitizer unit test, rerun quant job with alternative quant-merge schedule.

Nina Gomez: TL;DR: keep at 5% for now, applied per-session fallbacks, enterprise accounts require ops-confirm before routing change, added sanitizer and shadowing for faq slice. Reconvene in 90m or sooner if alerts.
